description: This is a Java test class for integration testing JWT token verification in a Spring Boot application. It contains multiple test cases to verify authorization behavior, token validity, and token refresh functionality.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifierIntegrationTest
classes.description: A Spring Boot integration test class for verifying JWT token handling, including authorization, token validation, expiration, and refresh token functionality.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfIncorrectRefreshTokenPassed
methods.description: Tests that an incorrect refresh token results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenNotPassed
methods.description: Tests that requests without a token are rejected with an unauthorized status.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenInvalidTokenPassed
methods.description: Tests that an invalid token in the Authorization header results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldAllowRequestIfTokenIsValid
methods.description: Tests that a valid JWT token allows access to protected resources.

methods.name: shouldGetUnauthenticatedIfTokenIsExpired
methods.description: Tests that an expired token results in an unauthenticated response.

methods.name: shouldReturnJwtAndRefreshTokenWhenProvidedCorrectRefreshToken
methods.description: Tests that providing a valid refresh token returns new JWT and refresh tokens.
